{
  "category": "incomplete-migration",
  "confidence": "high",
  "rationale": "The agent only bumped the dependency version in package.json and ran yarn install, but did not update the error message in src/marp-cli.ts to mention Microsoft Edge. The verifier applies a test patch that expects the error message to include 'Microsoft Edge' on non-Linux platforms, and the existing code only mentions Google Chrome and Chromium. This omission causes the test failure.",
  "evidence": [
    {
      "section": "verifier",
      "quote": "Expected pattern: /Microsoft Edge/
Received message: "It requires to install [Google Chrome](https://www.google.com/chrome/) for exporting.""
    },
    {
      "section": "candidate_patch",
      "quote": "diff --git a/package.json b/package.json
index 4a01a78..3a7254b 100644
--- a/package.json
+++ b/package.json
@@ -261,7 +261,7 @@
     "yaml": "^1.10.0"
   },
   "dependencies": {
-    "@marp-team/marp-cli": "^0.21.1",
+    "@marp-team/marp-cli": "^0.22.0","
    },
    {
      "section": "reference_patch",
      "quote": "diff --git a/src/marp-cli.ts b/src/marp-cli.ts
index cc304e29..5fe37d97 100644
--- a/src/marp-cli.ts
+++ b/src/marp-cli.ts
@@ -99,13 +99,18 @@ export default async function runMarpCli(...argv: string[]): Promise<void> {
       e instanceof CLIError &&
       e.errorCode === CLIErrorCode.NOT_FOUND_CHROMIUM
     ) {
-      const chromium =
-        process.platform === 'linux'
-          ? ' or [Chromium](https://www.chromium.org/)'
-          : ''
+      const browsers = ['[Google Chrome](https://www.google.com/chrome/)']
+
+      if (process.platform === 'linux')
+        browsers.push('[Chromium](https://www.chromium.org/)')
+
+      if (process.platform !== 'linux')
+        browsers.push('[Microsoft Edge](https://www.microsoft.com/edge)')
 
       throw new MarpCLIError(
-        `It requires to install [Google Chrome](https://www.google.com/chrome/)${chromium} for exporting.`
+        `It requires to install ${browsers
+          .join(', ')
+          .replace(/, ([^,]*)$/, ' or $1')} for exporting.`"
    }
  ],
  "alternatives": [],
  "needs_more_evidence": false,
  "missing_evidence": ""
}
